title: Wedding Food Testing | ElSyifa VLOG
description:
A little look into one of the most important parts of our wedding preparations — the food tasting for the reception of El Rumi & Syifa Hadju.

From selecting dishes to refining every detail, this experience was all about creating a menu that feels personal, memorable, and truly reflective of our celebration.

A fun and intimate glimpse into the process behind the scenes, filled with honest reactions and thoughtful choices.
